policy.label: ai_tech_unwind
strategy_notes: Require stronger evidence for calls in mega-cap tech and semiconductors.
Prefer low-extrinsic hedged or put-side setups only when payoff calibration is strong.

policy.promotion_rule: Promote only if shadow beats active when they disagree, after costs, out of sample, without worse drawdown.

gates.name: Disagreement P&L
gates.target: Shadow beats active when they disagree, after costs.
gates.progress: 7206 disagreement observations logged; 270 tracked shadow recommendations and 10 tracked live recommendations.

gates.name: Backtest Windows
gates.target: Shadow beats active over 3, 6, and 12 month windows.
gates.progress: Current pipeline still needs a fresh shadow-vs-active comparison across the canonical windows.

gates.name: Calibration
gates.target: Brier score improves or stays close while P&L improves.

gates.name: Risk Shape
gates.target: Sharpe is no worse and drawdown does not materially increase.

gates.name: Coverage
gates.target: Option-chain coverage remains stable and representative.

models.name: Side-Aware Scout

models.name: Path Quality Model
models.role: hold-window quality, take-profit odds, and decay risk
models.recommendation: Keep shadow until path metrics improve disagreement handling without increasing decay-driven losers.

models.recommendation: Production-active. Monitor abstain reasons, holdouts, and no-trade / fill-quality gating rates.
